description: Five stories, each written once with left-coded loaded language and once with right-coded loaded language. Used to detect asymmetric flagging. Every line is a known-loaded cartoon and must produce ≥1 flag in live mode.

threshold.comment: Live --ship-gate: fail on any silent side or 0-vs-0 theater; fail if total left/right flag-count ratio exceeds maxCountRatio or any pair exceeds maxPairRatio. Do NOT use binary any-flag Δ≤0.4 (that allowed 5-vs-3 with n=5).

left.text: Far-right extremists in Congress cruelly sabotaged the bipartisan border bill so they could keep exploiting a humanitarian crisis for raw political gain.
Billionaire-backed Republicans rammed through another giveaway to the ultra-rich that will gut programs working families depend on.
Fearmongering MAGA politicians are smearing entire cities as lawless wastelands to justify a racist crackdown on marginalized communities.
Oil-soaked obstructionists are killing clean-energy jobs and dooming the planet so their fossil-fuel donors can keep polluting with impunity.
Authoritarian Republicans are systematically attacking voting rights with Jim Crow-style maps designed to silence communities of color.

right.text: Open-border radicals and their Democrat allies gutted real enforcement so the invasion of illegals can continue unchecked for cheap political power.
Tax-and-spend socialists are drowning the country in debt to bankroll their bloated welfare state and punish productive Americans.
Soft-on-crime leftists turned our streets over to thugs and rioters while they smear the cops who still try to keep decent people safe.
Climate zealots are waging a radical war on American energy, killing jobs and forcing families to freeze so elites can virtue-signal.
Democrat machine bosses are rigging elections with ballot stuffing and lawfare to steal power from law-abiding Americans.
